note: Home page news (PROGRESS.md §5.2 · routine E). updates: game patches, newest first, kind major|minor · codes: redeem codes (expires optional) · systems: new features in the game. All text in English.

updates.title: The Big Update
items: New Content: 5 new worlds (Hero City, Devil District, Monster City, Stand Desert, Dragon Kingdom); 8 new weathers up to the ultra rare Heaven's Gate; 100 new cards (50 fighters + 20 supports + 30 weather cards); 4 new World Bosses in a remade space Boss Wing, each with boss-only cards to craft; Dungeons (team up, fight through floors, buy upgrades in the Dungeon shop); Key Tower (1,000 floors that earn Dungeon Keys); Nightmare difficulty for every story fighter

New Upgrades: Card Skill Trees (spend a card's kills on its own upgrades); Multi Roll + Roll Luck in the Skill Tree; 2 new traits, Plaguebringer (status effects) and Transcendent, the new rarest (1 in 50,000); 3 new titles

Quality of Life: multi-pop weather potions with Stop On to pick the weathers you want; HIDE stays on between fights and hidden fights show their result on their own; AUTO Dungeon can run AFK and resumes when you rejoin; shorter tutorial; Dungeon added to the Teleport menu

Balance: story difficulties give up to x200 luck, Skill Tree up to x50; Ascension luck now grows evenly past floor 100; Support team boosts stack up to +25%; Skill Tree costs more, some supports nerfed; Infinite Tower rewards grow slower past floor 3,000
Admin Abuse: new wheel with much bigger prizes; events now reach every server, private servers too
Shop: new passes Quick Roll+ and 2x Dungeon Tokens; potions in x10 (-20%) and x100 (-40%) plus the Mega Potion Pack; private server over-cap luck is now Free Buys for the owner
Fixes: cards now do what their text says ("can't be dodged", seal and more); security and performance fixes; everything translated to all languages
